verdict.rationale: Open Finance is an API-first product. Its core functions (balances, transactions, ownership verification and matching, data refresh, webhook subscription management) are documented as API endpoints, and Test Drive covers all API endpoints. There is no statement of UI/API parity, and onboarding steps such as project creation appear to happen in the developer-portal UI rather than through an API. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of portal/project/account administration, independent corroboration that nothing is UI-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Test Drive is a non-billable, unlimited plan that provides access to all Open Finance API endpoints.
